theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Nurses and caregivers need extreme clarity (High-Contrast) to avoid mistakes, but the brand explicitly requests a premium 'Foxory dark purple/neon purple style'. We use deep space purple-blacks to reduce OLED smearing, paired with highly legible off-white text and sharp neon purple accents to guide action.

placeholder_logo.description: Premium minimalist crescent/fox logo using an image + Lucide icon. Position image centrally, apply neon purple tint/overlay via CSS if possible, or pair it with a Lucide 'CalendarDays' icon colored in neon purple.
placeholder_logo.classes: w-12 h-12 rounded-xl border border-[#2D1B4E] bg-[#140C27] flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(168,85,247,0.2)]

login_screen.layout: Flex column, centered, min-h-screen bg-[#090514] p-6
login_screen.subtitle: text-sm text-center text-[#94A3B8] max-w-[280px]
login_screen.form_card: w-full bg-[#140C27] border border-[#2D1B4E] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xl

dashboard_header.layout: Sticky top-0 z-50 flex justify-between items-center px-4 py-3 bg-[#090514]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#2D1B4E]
dashboard_header.app_name_inline: text-base font-semibold text-white tracking-tight hidden sm:block
dashboard_header.account_badge: px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-[#A855F7]/30 bg-[#A855F7]/10 text-[#C084FC] text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wide uppercase

calendar_grid.container: grid grid-cols-7 gap-px bg-[#2D1B4E] rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-[#2D1B4E]
calendar_grid.day_cell: bg-[#090514] min-h-[80px] p-1 flex flex-col gap-1
calendar_grid.shift_chip: w-full px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-semibold truncate border

bottom_tab_bar.layout: Fixed bottom-0 w-full pb-safe pt-2 px-4 bg-[#140C27]/95 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-[#2D1B4E] flex justify-around items-center z-50
bottom_tab_bar.tab_item_inactive: flex flex-col items-center gap-1 text-[#64748B] transition-colors p-2
bottom_tab_bar.tab_item_active: flex flex-col items-center gap-1 text-[#A855F7] transition-colors p-2 drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(168,85,247,0.4)]

creator_signature_tag.description: Subtle, non-intrusive link indicating Foxory.net created the app.
creator_signature_tag.link_classes: text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-[#C084FC] underline decoration-[#A855F7]/40 underline-offset-4 transition-colors font-medium

xlsx_plan_summary.disclaimer: Reminder: This draft plan does not change the confirmed calendar.
xlsx_plan_summary.styling: Use bold font for headers, subtle gray background for the disclaimer row.

email_export.footer_text: This draft shift plan was created using Foxory Shift Calendar — created by Foxory.net.
email_export.styling: Add a small 1px subtle divider before the footer, use smaller font size and gray color for the footer text so it feels like a signature, not spam.

placeholder_crescent.description: Minimalist crescent moon to be used inside the placeholder logo container if no SVG is available.

testing_attributes.instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, representing the element's role (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='shift-day-chip-12').
